sources.title: City of De Soto, Kansas, Planning Commission agenda item 7b (22 September 2026): Consider Site Plan for Project JayHawk - Digital Realty (staff memo, site plan application and development plan set)
sources.source_family: City of De Soto planning records
sources.attribution: City of De Soto, Kansas
sources.summary: The 135-page agenda-item document opens with the Community Development Department's memo to the Planning Commission, meeting date 22 September 2026. Digital Realty has submitted a site plan to build a data center along Lexington Avenue between 99th and 103rd Streets; under the zoning regulations the Planning Commission reviews and approves site plans and 'makes the final decision'. The phase-one application proposes one two-storey data center 61.5 ft high with a 30 ft louver screen and about 225,000 sq ft per level (450,000 sq ft in total), 189 parking spaces, four loading docks, temporary construction trailers, one private electric substation and one operated by Evergy (Polaris). Staff found the architectural, landscaping, photometric, traffic, noise and stormwater submittals compliant and recommended approval with conditions to be met before occupancy permits. The attached application names the project 'Digital Astra North (Project Jayhawk)', location north-east of 103rd Street and Lexington Avenue, legal description portions of Astra Enterprise Park 2nd Plat, current and proposed zoning M-1, proposed use data center. The development plan set (Westwood, September 2026) gives the North Site as 281.136 acres; its existing-conditions sheet lists the North Site tracts with owner of record Atlantic Ventures LLC under a Kansas limited warranty deed recorded in Book 202603, Page 005325. The enclosed drainage study's Exhibit 2.5 (Post-Project Land Use Workmap, dated 26 June 2026) is a GeoPDF whose embedded registration locates the Project Jayhawk property boundary.
sources.date_semantics: The memo and its page headers are dated for the 22 September 2026 Planning Commission meeting; the PDF metadata creation time is 21 September 2026 and the city's posting date is not shown. 22 September 2026 is used as the publication date and the announcement observation. The document is the pre-decision staff report: it does not record the commission's vote, and no consent, site work or construction is taken from it.
sources.capture_note: Captured on the third attempt: two runs of the standard capture script timed out after 45 s on this 102 MB PDF, and the third used a copy of the script changed only in its timeout (300 s) and its capture-method label (recorded in compliance.log and the capture metadata).
sources.personal_data_note: The application and memo carry names, telephone numbers and e-mail addresses of individual applicant, owner and staff contacts; none are copied.
